caveat: Synthetic damage is not real damage. What is measured is how a segmenter responds to a controlled loss of contrast, edge definition and interior texture. Whether dying cells in a real plate degrade along the same axes is what a real experiment would settle.

design.detection_rule: a cell is found when one predicted object covers at least the coverage threshold of it
design.split: each annotated cell assigned to damaged or intact by coin flip
design.unit_of_analysis: acquisition group (one field of view at one timestamp). The paired difference is computed per image and the interval resamples whole groups, because cells within a frame are not independent trials.
